findings.title: Web management interface served over unencrypted HTTP
findings.evidence: Web interface responded on http://192.168.11.1/ without TLS encryption.
findings.impact: All web interactions, login attempts, and configurations are sent in plaintext and vulnerable to local eavesdropping.
findings.recommendation: Configure HTTPS encryption for the web management portal.

findings.title: Default admin credentials exposed in login page HTML
findings.evidence: Login page HTML contains hidden username or password values (e.g. 'admin').
findings.impact: The login page HTML reveals default credentials to anyone viewing the source code.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from client-side HTML.

findings.title: Admin credentials stored in Base64 Authorization cookie
findings.evidence: Authorization cookie or script stores Base64 encoded credentials without HttpOnly/Secure flags.
findings.impact: The cookie can expose admin credentials because Base64 is reversible and the cookie lacks HttpOnly/Secure flags.
findings.recommendation: Use secure server-side session tokens with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite attributes.
